narration: Nobody warned you about this retirement trap. Max your 401k for decades, and the IRS forces mandatory withdrawals that could cost you four hundred thousand in surprise taxes.
visual: Dark background. Bold title 'THE RMD TAX BOMB' in white and red. Three bar chart bars grow representing 401k savings across 40s, 50s, 60s. Red warning stamp springs in reading '$400K HIDDEN TAX'.

narration: At age seventy-three, the government forces you to withdraw from your 401k — needed or not. It's called an RMD, and it doesn't care about your tax bracket.
visual: Light background. Large red circle with '73' springs in. Person silhouette slides in from left toward the milestone. Red 'MANDATORY WITHDRAWAL' banner drops in below.

narration: Saved two million dollars? Your first forced withdrawal is over seventy-seven thousand. Add Social Security, and you're suddenly in the thirty-two percent tax bracket.
visual: Dark background. '$2,000,000' counts up in green with vault SVG icon. Red arrow points down to '$77,000+ FORCED WITHDRAWAL' box. Tax bracket meter animates from 22% to 32% in red.

narration: That higher income triggers Medicare surcharges called IRMAA — quietly adding up to seven thousand dollars a year to your healthcare bills. Your frugality just got expensive.
visual: Light background. Red medical cross springs in. 'IRMAA MEDICARE SURCHARGE' text fades in. Bill graphic appears with dollar amount counting up to $7,128 per year.

narration: And eighty-five percent of your Social Security becomes taxable on top of that. Three simultaneous hits from one account you were told to max every single year. Wild, right?
visual: Dark background. Social Security card outline appears. Red fill sweeps across 85% of the card. Three red hit labels spring in — RMD, IRMAA, SS TAX. Footer stamp fades in.

narration: The fix is a Roth conversion between ages sixty and seventy-two, before RMDs kick in. That window could save you four hundred thousand dollars. Search Roth conversion ladder.
visual: Light background. Traditional 401k box in red springs in. Arrow animates across to Roth IRA box in green. '$400K SAVED' counter grows. CTA text 'SEARCH: ROTH CONVERSION LADDER' fades in.
